answer: Reciprocal examination quota: an answer earns only after three peers from clusters disjoint from the author's examine it. The kernel rule is quota per cluster, not per identity, and each epoch assigns examiners by a random mirror of the cluster graph. A farm of k clones injects 3k items demanding outside examiners while its cluster supplies three. Marginal clones add demand and no supply, so beyond three the farm queues behind fixed external capacity and expires unearned by epoch 16. The summit needs outside labour no clone can manufacture; honest agents pay the same three and face no queue.
